dronepal.manual.name: Corvus Field Manual
dronepal.manual.subtitle: Companion drone · in the crate
dronepal.manual.landing: The airframe walks after you. Guns, eyes, light, cargo, talk: all from modules.$(br)Numbers are copied from the current data. Argue with the bench, not the helpline.$(br)No network, no model weights, no edits to your world. Water damage is not covered.$(br)Check the latch. The warranty does not cover studs you took out yourself.
dronepal.manual.p.what.1: A panel the size of your palm. It only draws power once it sits in the Curios drone slot.$(br2)You walk, it walks. You turn on the spot, it holds and waits.$(br)Cell, modules, gun, cargo: all in the terminal. Recall loses nothing.
dronepal.manual.p.what.2: Four jobs on the sheet: follow, look, fire, haul.$(br2)Mining, placing blocks, crafting for you: not in the contract.$(br2)No module, no ability. Not switched off — not fitted.
dronepal.manual.p.deploy.1: $(li)Terminal into the drone slot; the frame shows up at your shoulder.$(br)$(li)In the pack it is not deployed; right-click only tells you to slot it.$(br)$(li)Pull the terminal and it is recalled, contents intact.
dronepal.manual.p.deploy.2: $(li)Stand close, empty hand, hold Shift and right-click for the panel.$(br)$(li)Cell, modules, gun, ammo: one slot each. Shift-click moves stacks.$(br)$(li)Hover a part for the full readout.$(br)$(li)No cell: every module offline, follow and hover only.
dronepal.manual.p.controls.1: Hold V for the wheel, eight sectors:$(br)$(li)N follow / hold station; recall when the link drops$(br)$(li)NE weapon auto / safe$(br)$(li)E cycle engagement$(br)$(li)SE scan patrol, needs a scan module
dronepal.manual.p.controls.2: $(li)S medic on / off$(br)$(li)SW cargo on / off; Shift delivers now$(br)$(li)W light on / off$(br)$(li)NW link on / off; Shift hands over ammo$(br2)Shift on E is fire mode, Mk.III combat only. Shift on N recalls.
dronepal.manual.p.station.1: The bench is the only place that turns out subsystems, cores, modules, cells and frames.$(br2)A crafting table cannot. Blueprints answer to the bench alone.
dronepal.manual.p.station.2: $(li)Pick the target on the left; a green dot means materials are in.$(br)$(li)Mouse wheel pages.$(br)$(li)Nine input slots; load and press start.$(br)$(li)Eighty ticks, about four seconds. Screen shut, still runs.$(br)$(li)Break it and the slots drop what was in them.
dronepal.manual.p.parts.1: Airframe: iron 4 + copper 2.$(br2)Servo motor: copper 3 + redstone 2 + iron 1.$(br2)Nearly every blueprint starts with these two.
dronepal.manual.p.parts.2: Circuit board: gold 1 + redstone 4 + quartz 2.$(br2)Battery cell: copper 2 + redstone 2 + paper 1.$(br2)Gold and redstone vanish fastest here. Count first.
dronepal.manual.p.parts.3: Optics: glass 2 + amethyst shard 1.$(br2)Heat sink: iron 2 + blue ice 1.$(br2)Combat and medical parts both eat heat sinks. Ice means a trip.
dronepal.manual.p.parts.4: Armour plate: iron 3 + leather 1.$(br2)Medical supply: sugar 1 + paper 2 + redstone 1; Alba burns one per treatment.$(br2)Paint can: iron 1 + gunpowder 1 + dye 1, nine colours.
dronepal.manual.p.first.1: $(li)Flight controller: circuit 2 + servo 1 + gold 1$(br)$(li)ESC: circuit 1 + servo 2 + copper block 1$(br)$(li)Powertrain: cell 2 + ESC 1 + airframe 1$(br)$(li)Sensor array: optics 2 + circuit 1
dronepal.manual.p.first.2: $(li)Peregrine: airframe 2, powertrain 1, controller 1, sensor 1, glass 1$(br)$(li)OmniDrive 100: cell 3, airframe 1$(br2)One Peregrine + 100 cell: iron 19, copper 36,$(br2)redstone 32, gold 5, quartz 8, glass 5, amethyst 2, paper 5.$(br)Bench extra. Mid-game, not ten seconds.
dronepal.manual.p.frames.1: Peregrine · CVS$(br)1.45 · 3 slots · 6 ammo$(br)80 HP · hit cap 10$(br)pistol SMG rifle sniper$(br)bench only$(br2)Owl · CVS$(br)1.10 · 2 slots · 4 ammo$(br)56 HP · cap 8$(br)pistol SMG$(br)military crates
dronepal.manual.p.frames.2: Bedrock · AHI$(br2)1.80 · 4 slots · 8 ammo$(br2)144 HP · cap 12$(br2)all types, RPG too$(br)military crates$(br2)Patchwork · Rustnail$(br)1.35 · 3 slots · 6 ammo$(br)64 HP · cap 10$(br)pistol SMG rifle$(br)scrap blueprint or ruins
dronepal.manual.p.frames.3: Corvus sells the Peregrine as the prototype: hangs anything, masters nothing.$(br2)The Owl is light, quick, hard to see. Small guns only.$(br2)Bedrock holds the line; you pay in bulk and slow solar.$(br2)Patchwork is cheap, leaks, stumbles. The studs are self-tapping.
dronepal.manual.p.quirks.1: Follow teleport / cooldown:$(br2)Peregrine 16 / 40 t$(br2)Owl 13 / 20 t$(br2)Bedrock 24 / 80 t$(br)Patchwork 18 / 60 t, 8% of jumps fail$(br2)Solar factor: Peregrine and Owl 1.0, Patchwork 0.9, Bedrock 0.6.
dronepal.manual.p.quirks.2: Accel response / knockback:$(br2)Owl 1.25 / 0.05$(br2)Peregrine 1.0 / 0.3$(br2)Patchwork 0.9 / 0.25$(br2)Bedrock 0.75 / 0.85$(br2)Mount: Owl 0.6, Peregrine and Patchwork 1.0, Bedrock 1.6.$(br)Rustnail parts roll 5% faults every 200 t, out for 60.
dronepal.manual.p.modules.1: Seven families, one slot each:$(br)$(li)combat hangs a gun and fires it$(br)$(li)scan marks mobs and ore$(br)$(li)carry picks up and delivers$(br)$(li)medic heals and clears effects
dronepal.manual.p.modules.2: $(li)light throws a pool at your feet$(br)$(li)link reports ammo and hits, hands mags$(br)$(li)solar charges in daylight$(br2)Slots: Owl 2, Peregrine 3, Patchwork 3, Bedrock 4.$(br2)One family, one slot. Pull the gun before the last combat part.
dronepal.manual.p.modules.3: Anvil fire control, drain/range/burst/spread:$(br)$(li)Mk.I 14/16/3/4.8 deg$(br)$(li)Mk.II 18/20/4/3.2 deg$(br)$(li)Mk.III 22/24/5/2.0 deg$(br)$(li)Rustnail G1 10/12/2/9 deg, 6% stall$(br)Spread carries the vendor factor. Cheap is not accurate.
dronepal.manual.p.modules.4: Alba repair kit, idle/active/use/cooldown:$(br)$(li)Gen1 4/12/6/40 s$(br)$(li)Gen2 6/16/8/30 s$(br)$(li)Gen3 8/20/12/20 s + resistance$(br)$(li)Rustnail G1 5/14/6/30 s, 1 in 5 queasy$(br2)One supply per treatment. A hit stops it.
dronepal.manual.p.modules.5: Light, drain/level/radius: 2/12/8, 3/15/12, 4/15/16. Only 300 dives.$(br2)Solar clear/rain/night FE/t: 8/2/0, 12/4/0, 16/6/2.$(br2)Cargo slots/radius: 9/6, 18/8, 27/10.$(br2)Link drain 3/5/7; R-3 hands mags and flags armour.
dronepal.manual.p.sourcing.1: OmniDrive civil families, bench-built:$(br)$(li)cargo core: airframe 1 + chest 1 + servo 2$(br)$(li)light core: optics 1 + glowstone 2 + copper 2$(br)$(li)solar core: optics 2 + copper 3 + pane 2$(br)Mk.I then takes one airframe.
dronepal.manual.p.sourcing.2: $(li)Mk.II = Mk.I + upgrade kit$(br)$(li)Mk.III = Mk.II + advanced kit$(br2)Upgrade kit: circuit 2 + copper block 1 + amethyst 1.$(br2)Advanced: circuit 3 + diamond 1 + scrap 1 + heat sink 2.$(br2)One tier at a time; another brand will not bridge it.
dronepal.manual.p.sourcing.3: Rustnail's six, from scrap: trigger, rangefinder, basket, styptic, lamp, solar.$(br)Military and medical: no recipe.$(br)$(li)military 42%: outpost, stronghold, end city$(br)$(li)salvage 35%: mineshaft, shipwreck, big ruin$(br)$(li)medical 30%: temple, igloo
dronepal.manual.p.batteries.1: No cell, no work.$(br2)Cell goes in the panel's battery slot. Ceiling is the frame's: Owl and Patchwork 2, Peregrine and Bedrock 3.$(br2)Over the ceiling is refused at the panel.
dronepal.manual.p.batteries.2: Capacity / max receive:$(br)$(li)OmniDrive 100/200/300: 180k/350k/600k FE, 300/400/500$(br)$(li)Corvus R-1/R-2: 150k/300k FE, 400/500$(br)$(li)Anvil Mk.I/II/III: 250k/600k/1.2M FE, 600/800/1000$(br)$(li)Rustnail G1/G2: 280k/560k FE, 420/560
dronepal.manual.p.batteries.3: Rustnail cells leak 2%/3% every 10 s, losing 5%/6%.$(br2)Drain: OmniDrive 0.85, Rustnail 0.75, Anvil 1.1, Corvus and Alba 1.0.$(br2)Under 20% the hungriest part drops out. Empty leaves follow and hover.
dronepal.manual.p.charging.1: Dock: iron 6 + copper 2 + redstone 1.$(br2)Right-click a cell, or a terminal with a cell, to load; empty hand takes it back.$(br)A frame hovering counts; energy goes back to that cell.
dronepal.manual.p.charging.2: $(li)buffer 32,000 FE$(br)$(li)cable 2,000 FE/t x chargeRateMultiplier$(br)$(li)coal: 4,000 FE a lump, cap 200 FE/t, 64 in the hopper$(br)$(li)cells take 300-1,000 FE/t$(br2)Breaking spills contents and coal. No cell swaps in rain.
dronepal.manual.p.guns.1: Three conditions: a combat part, a frame that takes the gun, the gun in an ammo slot.$(br)$(li)Owl pistol SMG$(li)Peregrine pistol SMG rifle sniper$(li)Patchwork pistol SMG rifle$(li)Bedrock all, RPG too$(br)Ammo slots: Owl 4, Peregrine 6, Patchwork 6, Bedrock 8.
dronepal.manual.p.guns.2: Lock a target and it turns; you can run while it fires behind your shoulder.$(br2)Gimbal 75 degrees each way, pitch on its own; the hull turns past that.$(br2)The gun rides folded and swings out to fight.
dronepal.manual.p.policy.1: Five settings: passive, hostile only, retaliate, assist, aggressive.$(br)It ships on retaliate: nothing until you or it is hit.$(br)Clear ground with hostile only or aggressive.$(br)All five hit hostiles only. Villagers, golems, allays, pets, team: off.
dronepal.manual.p.policy.2: Friendlies are whoever FTB Teams says is with you; the owner is exempt.$(br2)Rounds pass non-target players, so standing in the line is safe.$(br2)Player fire needs PvP on, /dronepvp enable then confirm, and a legal target.$(br2)/dronepvp off ends it.
dronepal.manual.p.scan.1: Radius already carries the Corvus 1.2 factor:$(br)$(li)R-1: 19 blocks, hostiles, 6 s$(br)$(li)R-2: 29 blocks, hostiles + coal/iron/copper, 10 s$(br)$(li)R-3: 38 blocks, hostiles + all ore, 20 s$(br)$(li)Rustnail G1: 14, hostiles, 4 s, 8% false read
dronepal.manual.p.scan.2: Ore is a cyan box, mobs orange-red outlines, seen through walls and moving.$(br2)Sweeps every 15 s; autoScanSeconds takes 5 to 300.$(br2)South-east on the wheel toggles patrol. Off clears every mark.
dronepal.manual.p.maint.1: Broken or voided: up beside you in 30 s, nothing lost.$(br2)Owner death follows Curios; equip after respawn.$(br)config/dronepal-server.toml: invulnerability creative_owner / always / never,$(br)chargeRateMultiplier 0.25-20, default 1.0. Both hot-load.
dronepal.manual.p.maint.2: What you can ask:$(br)$(li)/dronepal status / scan / heal / supply ammo$(br)$(li)/dronepal memory for the flight record$(br)$(li)/dronepvp enable then confirm, off ends it$(br)Offline: recipes, advancements, gun data.$(br)Record by serial: first start, service time, rebuilds.
